onboarding.welcomeDescription: Would you like a quick tour of the application? We'll show you step by step how everything works.

welcome.title: Welcome, administrator!
welcome.description: As an administrator, you set up the entire application. Let's walk through the most important steps together.

orchestras.title: Create orchestras
orchestras.description: Start by creating orchestras. Each orchestra has its own music lists and rehearsals. Members are linked to orchestras so they only see their own music.

members.title: Add members
members.description: Add members and link them to orchestras and instruments. Assign the right role: member, music committee, conductor or administrator.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Set your association's name and logo. These are shown on the login screen and in the navigation bar.

rehearsals.title: Plan rehearsals
rehearsals.description: Set default rehearsal days (e.g. every Tuesday) and automatically generate a schedule for a period. Optionally connect Spond for attendance tracking.

done.title: Ready to go!
done.description: You can now get started. Tip: the music committee can upload music pieces and organize them into lists. You can always restart this tour via the button in the navigation bar.

welcome.title: Welcome, music committee!
welcome.description: As music committee, you manage the music library. We'll show you how to upload and organize music pieces.

upload.title: Upload music pieces
upload.description: Upload PDF files of music pieces. The filename is automatically parsed: Title_arranger_instrument_tuning_groupnumber.pdf. You can create a new list directly when uploading.

lists.title: List management
lists.description: Organize music pieces into lists per orchestra. Add titles, set YouTube links, manage the order and activate/deactivate lists.

pieces.title: Manage music pieces
pieces.description: View and edit all music pieces. You can search, filter by instrument, and bulk select and delete pieces.

titles.title: Titles and metadata
titles.description: Manage titles with extra information: YouTube links, MP3 previews, duration, difficulty level and genres.

instruments.title: Instruments and aliases
instruments.description: Manage instruments and their aliases. Aliases ensure filenames are automatically linked to the right instrument (e.g. 'Altsax' → 'Alto Saxophone').

done.title: Ready to go!
done.description: You can now start managing music. Members will automatically only see pieces for their instrument. You can always restart this tour via the button in the navigation bar.

welcome.title: Welcome, conductor!
welcome.description: As conductor, you plan rehearsals and keep track of the music. We'll show you the most important features.

rehearsals.title: Plan rehearsals
rehearsals.description: Create rehearsals, set default days and automatically generate a schedule. For each rehearsal you can specify which pieces to rehearse and for which orchestra.

pieces.title: Repertoire per rehearsal
pieces.description: For each rehearsal you can add pieces to rehearse. Members see this in their overview so they can prepare.

mymusic.title: View music
mymusic.description: Via 'My Music' you can view the music lists of your orchestras and download pieces.

done.title: Ready to go!
done.description: You can now start planning rehearsals. You can always restart this tour via the button in the navigation bar.

welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.description: Here you'll find all your music and the rehearsal schedule. We'll quickly show you where everything is.

mymusic.title: My Music
mymusic.description: Here you'll find your music pieces, sorted by orchestra and list. Download the pieces you need for your instrument.

rehearsals.title: Rehearsals
rehearsals.description: View when the next rehearsals are, which pieces will be rehearsed and who will be attending.

issues.title: Report issues
issues.description: See an error in a music piece? Wrong notes, missing measures? Report it here so the music committee can fix it.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.description: Set your instruments so you automatically see the right pieces. You can also change your password and set up two-factor authentication here.

done.title: All set!
done.description: You now know where everything is. Enjoy making music! You can always restart this tour via the button in the navigation bar.
